newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Fire damages Bahrain building, no casualty reports.
newsitem.headline: Fire damages Bahrain building, no casualty reports.

text.p: A fire bomb caused a blaze on Monday in a five-storey building in Bahrain, a government official said.
Witnesses said the fire badly damaged a shop on the ground floor of the building in the capital Manama, but there were no reports of casualties.
"Four masked people attacked the shop and threw a fire bomb. The blaze damaged the shop but there were no casualties," the official told Reuters.

The fire was the latest in a series to hit the island, the Gulf's main financial and banking centre, in the past two weeks. The incidents have been described by a government official as "continued acts of terrorism".
Four Asians died from smoke inhalation and a fifth was seriously wounded on June 13 after an arson attack on a shop in the same area.
Last week, Bahrain's State Security Court jailed seven Shi'ite Moslems for terms of up to five and a half years on charges of executing arson attacks.
Shi'ite Moslems have launched sporadic attacks since December 1994 to demand political and economic reforms by the Sunni-led government.
